i_tibetan_terrier.lore.epic: Shook its shaggy coat in the village square and caused a small snowstorm.

i_langur.lore.common: Sits on the old town rooftops and drops leaves on the heads of people taking photographs.
i_langur.lore.legendary: Guarded the hilltop fort so faithfully that the keeper gave it the only key. It mostly uses it as a toy.
